name: Hidden Valley Camp
description_short: Overnight camp on 350 acres with a private lake in Freedom, Maine, for ages 8 to 14, with teen programs (adventure trips, advanced arts, counselor training, apprenticeships) for 14 to 17. Known for arts such as glass and ceramics, plus animals, riding, water sports and outdoor trips. Most campers stay one roughly four-week session; tuition is all-inclusive.

swim_waterfront_notes: Private lake for canoeing, windsurfing, fishing and kayaking, plus a 75 by 25 foot heated pool with swim instruction at all levels. Red Cross lifeguards, buddy system, swim evaluations on opening day, life jackets while boating.

warnings: The teen program listings are unclear. Adventures and AWACs say '1st and 2nd Session', which could mean the program runs in each session or that one price covers both. Arts and Apprentices say '1st or 2nd Session'.
The early registration discount (10%) ends October 31, a little over two weeks after today (2026-10-13). Without a year given, it most likely means Oct 31, 2026, for the 2027 season.
Half sessions are for new campers only. AWACs need to be former campers, and Apprentices need at least one summer at HVC.
'Registration is open' does not mean every session still has room.
